Lori Gardner is a voice actress for the English dub of . She is currently affiliated Arcieri & Associates Talent.

==Biography==
Gardner has been acting since 2002, only getting roles on occasion, usually in short films. She then transitioned into voice acting starting in 2013, when she started providing the voice of Aldith during of the .
